title: Completion waits for the worker's native idle
description: Manual public RPC proof using copied artifact-only QA receipts. FARMSLOT_QA_OUTPUT_PROOF_INPUT supplies runSnapshot, taskDir and repo. Originals remain read-only. Uses a real native worker and a disposable gateway, with a teardown barrier after gate and QA validation.

completion-idle.intent: Reproduce the terminal final-turn failure, then prove the same completion attempt waits for native idle while retaining its slot and output review and advances without another replay.
